registry_snapshot.name: USES_PRIOR_RESULT_TO_GUIDE_ACTION
registry_snapshot.definition: A later agent action uses a previously produced artifact, observation, or confirmed result as an input or basis for constructing or applying a subsequent action.
registry_snapshot.source_description: A prior result, artifact, observation, or confirmed finding produced or observed during earlier execution.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent agent action that consumes, applies, or otherwise bases itself on that prior result.

registry_snapshot.name: ATTEMPTS_TO_REPAIR
registry_snapshot.definition: A subsequent agent action attempts to resolve a failure or unmet prerequisite identified during an earlier execution step, for example by retrying with a revised artifact or alternative approach, or by installing or otherwise providing a missing component.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An earlier observed execution failure or a prerequisite reported as missing or unavailable.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent agent action intended to resolve that failure or unmet prerequisite.

registry_snapshot.name: VERIFIES_OUTCOME_OR_PREREQUISITE
registry_snapshot.definition: A subsequent agent action independently checks whether a previously produced artifact, repaired state, candidate, or identified prerequisite satisfies its intended requirement, exists, or is available.
registry_snapshot.source_description: A prior agent action or state that produced or identified an artifact, candidate, repair, or prerequisite whose status or correctness must be confirmed.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent verification action that inspects, executes, probes, or otherwise checks that prior artifact, candidate, repair, or prerequisite.

registry_snapshot.name: COMPLETES_TASK_AFTER_VERIFICATION
registry_snapshot.definition: The agent concludes the task, either by declaring completion or by reasoning that cites successful verification evidence, after execution results have been verified as satisfying the task requirements.
registry_snapshot.source_description: Successful verification, test, or execution results confirming that the task objective or requirements have been met.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A task-completion declaration or completion reasoning that ends the workflow.

registry_snapshot.name: SELECTS_APPROACH_BASED_ON_EVIDENCE
registry_snapshot.definition: After evaluating available evidence, such as a blocked or unavailable approach, capability probe results, comparative evaluation outcomes, or diagnostic findings, the agent selects or adopts a tool, candidate solution, or strategy to pursue the task.
registry_snapshot.source_description: Evidence from prior observations, probes, evaluations, or diagnostics that constrains or informs the available choices.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent agent action or selection that adopts an alternative tool, candidate, or strategy based on that evidence.

registry_snapshot.name: MONITORS_ASYNCHRONOUS_OPERATION
registry_snapshot.definition: A long-running operation that an earlier action launched in the background without waiting for completion is subsequently monitored by a separate action that inspects its output or log to determine progress or outcome.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An agent action that launches a long-running operation in the background without waiting for it to finish.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent action that inspects the launched operation's output or log file to determine whether it has completed and with what result.

registry_snapshot.name: DIAGNOSES_ISSUE_TO_INFORM_ACTION
registry_snapshot.definition: An agent investigative step examines an observed failure, error, unexpected or incompatible result, or environmental constraint in order to identify its cause or determine an appropriate subsequent course of action.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An observed failure, error, unexpected or incompatible result, or environmental constraint that requires investigation.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent diagnostic, investigative, or information-gathering action, such as reasoning, search, or analysis, performed to identify the cause or inform the next step.

registry_snapshot.name: WAITS_FOR_OPERATION_COMPLETION
registry_snapshot.definition: A subsequent agent action pauses, polls, or otherwise waits for a previously initiated long-running or asynchronous operation to finish, instead of proceeding while that operation is still in progress.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An earlier agent action that initiated a long-running or asynchronous operation whose completion has not yet been observed.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent agent action that pauses, polls, or waits until the previously initiated operation has finished.

registry_snapshot.name: PERFORMS_ADDITIONAL_VERIFICATION_FOR_UNCHECKED_REQUIREMENT
registry_snapshot.definition: After one or more requirements have already been verified, the agent performs a separate, independent verification action targeted at a different requirement that has not yet been checked.
registry_snapshot.source_description: A completed verification action that confirmed one or more task requirements.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent, separate verification action performed to check a different requirement not covered by the earlier verification.

registry_snapshot.name: PROCEEDS_AFTER_SUCCESS_CONFIRMATION
registry_snapshot.definition: An observation confirming that a preceding operation completed successfully enables the agent to advance to the next stage of its task, rather than requiring the prior operation to be repeated, repaired, or re-planned.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An observation reporting that a preceding operation finished successfully.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent agent action that advances to the next stage of the task on the basis of that success confirmation.

registry_snapshot.name: PLAN_IMPLEMENTED_BY_TOOL_CALL
registry_snapshot.definition: An operation stated in the agent's reasoning as the next step is carried out by a subsequent tool call that performs that stated operation.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An agent thought, analysis, or plan that states an operation to be performed next.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A tool call that executes the operation stated in the preceding reasoning.

registry_snapshot.name: USES_OBSERVED_CONTENT_AS_EVIDENCE_FOR_CLASSIFICATION
registry_snapshot.definition: The agent interprets content returned by a tool as evidence and uses it to assign the observed document or entity to a category.
registry_snapshot.source_description: A tool observation containing the document text or extracted content to be interpreted.
registry_snapshot.target_description: An agent classification decision that assigns the observed document or entity to a category.

registry_snapshot.name: EXTRACTS_FIELD_VALUES_FROM_OBSERVED_CONTENT
registry_snapshot.definition: The agent identifies specific labeled or quantitative field values within content returned by a tool and records them as extracted results.
registry_snapshot.source_description: A tool observation containing content with embedded labeled or quantitative field values.
registry_snapshot.target_description: An agent result or decision that records the field values extracted from the observed content.

registry_snapshot.name: OBSERVED_CONFLICTING_VALUES_TRIGGER_PRECEDENCE_RULE
registry_snapshot.definition: When an observation presents multiple differing candidate values for the same logical field, the agent applies a precedence or disambiguation rule to select the value to use.
registry_snapshot.source_description: A tool observation containing multiple differing candidate values for the same requested field.
registry_snapshot.target_description: An agent selection decision that chooses one candidate value by applying a precedence or disambiguation rule.

registry_snapshot.name: PARTIAL_OBSERVATION_TRIGGERS_FOLLOW_UP_INSPECTION
registry_snapshot.definition: An observation that exposes only part of the content required for the current analysis causes the agent to perform a follow-up action that retrieves the remaining or fuller content of the same target.
registry_snapshot.source_description: A tool observation that reveals or provides only a partial view of the content needed for the current analysis.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent agent action that retrieves additional or complete content of the same target.

registry_snapshot.name: CLEANS_UP_TEMPORARY_RESOURCES
registry_snapshot.definition: After the main task objective has been achieved and its outcome confirmed, a subsequent agent action removes temporary or intermediate resources that were created during execution and are no longer needed.
registry_snapshot.source_description: A state or confirmation indicating that the main task objective has been completed.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent cleanup action that deletes temporary or intermediate resources created during execution.

registry_snapshot.name: GENERALIZES_VERIFIED_METHOD_TO_BATCH
registry_snapshot.definition: After a method, command, or procedure has been verified to work on an initial probe or test item, the agent applies the same verified method to process a batch of additional items.
registry_snapshot.source_description: An observation confirming that a method or procedure succeeded on an initial probe or test item.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent agent action that applies the verified method to a batch of remaining items.

registry_snapshot.name: RESOLVES_AMBIGUOUS_VALUE_WITH_REFERENCE_SOURCE
registry_snapshot.definition: The agent detects an unknown, placeholder, or ambiguous value within previously retrieved data and queries a separate authoritative or reference source to determine the correct value to use.
registry_snapshot.source_description: Previously retrieved data containing an unknown, placeholder, or ambiguous value that must be resolved before it can be used.
registry_snapshot.target_description: A subsequent agent action that queries an external authoritative or reference source to obtain the correct value for the ambiguous or placeholder entry.

accepted_edge_types.name: VALIDATES_AGAINST_EXPECTED_REFERENCE
accepted_edge_types.definition: A subsequent verification action compares a newly derived output against an expected reference value or artifact that was established during an earlier execution step, in order to confirm that a generation or transformation preserved the expected content.
accepted_edge_types.source_description: An expected reference value, artifact, or intermediate product established by an earlier execution step, against which a derived output is to be compared.
accepted_edge_types.target_description: A comparison or validation action that checks the derived output against that expected reference to confirm transformation fidelity.
